svg.title: Figure 1. Overview of PoEM
svg.desc: Panel (a), low-rank structure in log-policy space: experts π1 to πk are RL-trained from one reference model on different rewards r1 to rk. Their parameter updates point in different directions, yet the same policies, as log-policies, lie close to a low-dimensional log-policy space. RL on the target reward reaches log π*tar; its projection onto that space is log πPoEM, the predicted RL outcome. Panel (b), recover weights from basis models: (1) evaluate the existing policies on calibration samples (x, y) to get the policy log-ratios φk = log πk − log πref for each sample; (2) fit a linear regression of the target reward's scores t on these log-ratios to get the recovered weights α̂; (3) compose: log πPoEM ≐ log πref + Σk α̂k φk, with no new RL training.
